messages:
maria-oncall: Heads-up — EUW3 flirted with OOM last night, ~02:17 UTC. Autoscaler did one reactive scale but preemptive provisioning didn’t trigger. Latency p95 climbed from 95ms -> 400ms for ~14 minutes, and we saw ~7% request shedding on low-priority routes.

jake-sre: timeline pls (quick).

maria-oncall: short timeline: marketing promo 01:50 -> traffic ramped 01:55-02:10. Cluster GPU util hit 92% at 02:12, sustained >94% 02:14-02:28. Autoscaler reacted at 02:21 (slow because lookback window = 5m). Preemptive rule uses predictive buffer (72h moving avg + day-of-week multiplier) but the signal under-estimated the promo spike.

sasha-ml: did model hot starts/KV cause extra pressure? last week KV eviction looked noisy.

maria-oncall: KV eviction spiked but only after util >95%. Not root cause. Primary was insufficient pre-allocated GPU headroom for the sudden high-concurrency chat sessions.

oliver-infra: quick config snippet that failed to trigger:
```yaml
autoscaler:
  lookback: 300s
  provision_threshold: 0.8     # current
  predictive_window_hours: 72
  smoothing_alpha: 0.2
```
Predictive signal underestimated because our promo multiplier table had no entry for this creative channel (new marketing segment).

jake-sre: ok — two issues: predictive data sparsity for new channels, and provision_threshold=0.8 too high for spikes. Suggest lowering to 0.65 and add a short-window spike detector (30s) to catch bursts.

oliver-infra: agreed. Proposal:
- provision_threshold -> 0.65
- add spike_detector: if util_delta > 8% over 30s, trigger pre-warm of +10 GPUs
- backfill policy: soft-fallback to burst capacity pool (if available) before shedding
I'll open a PR for config + integration tests.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by oliver-infra for autoscaler config change (staging run).

rachel-finance: cost note — rough calc: extra pre-warm headroom with 10 GPUs x 6 hours/day ~ 60 GPU-hours/day => ~1.8k GPU-hours/month. At midpoint rate that's ~\u20ac5k/mo if we keep always-on. But most of this is only on promo days. We should cap burst budget and prefer short-lived autoscale.

jake-sre: action plan (short):
1) oliver-infra: lower threshold -> 0.65 and add spike_detector (PR by EOD)
2) oliver-infra + sasha-ml: add promo-channel tagging to predictive input so new channels inherit similar segments (by Mon)
3) maria-oncall: add dashboard alert for util_delta > 6% in 1m with playbook link (tomorrow)
4) rachel-finance: propose burst budget window + approval flow (this week)
5) eng-sre: run chaos test in staging to simulate 3x promo ramp (Wed run)

sasha-ml: also recommend using a short-term ML ensemble (weekday + recency features) for 24-72h forecasts — will prototype a 1-week horizon model next sprint.

maria-oncall: follow-ups: please tag PRs with thread_ts=2027654321. I'll run a retro doc after config deploy and collect metrics for next promo (p95, shedding %, GPU-hours).

rachel-finance: sounding good — please include cost delta estimates in PR description.

oliver-infra: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/autoscaler/pull/421 (staging tests green). Will schedule rollback window and run canary deploy Thu 09:00 UTC.

maria-oncall: thanks — canary + post-canary monitoring required. I'll run charts at +15m, +1h, +6h.

costbot: estimate for proposed change (provision_threshold 0.65 + spike_detector): projected +120 GPU-hours/month on average (~\u20ac3.4k/mo) but reduces expected shed rate by ~80% on promo days.

jake-sre: good trade. If observed cost >> estimate, we toggle burst to soft-fallback-only.

maria-oncall: closing note: root cause = predictive gap (new channel) + conservative threshold. Fix = config change + predictive input hygiene + short-window spike detector. Will summarize in the incident tracker. :white_check_mark:

---
Action items summary (owner -> due):
- oliver-infra -> PR + canary (Thu 09:00 UTC)
- sasha-ml -> promo-channel tagging + 1-week prototype (next sprint)
- maria-oncall -> monitoring playbook + post-canary checks (Thu)
- rachel-finance -> burst budget proposal (Fri)
- eng-sre -> staging chaos test (Wed)
